Target: Apple (AAPL). Apple develops and sells personal computing devices including iPhone, Mac and iPad, with operating systems and digital services.

Focal announcement: Apple announces changes to iOS in Brazil.

Decision cutoff: 2026-06-18T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: Apple announces changes to iOS in Brazil. Published: 2026-06-18. URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/06/apple-announces-changes-to-ios-in-brazil.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: Apple today announced changes impacting iOS apps in Brazil that reflect a recent agreement with Brazil’s competition regulator, the Conselho Administrativo de Defesa Econômica (CADE). While these safeguards do not eliminate the new risks, they are essential to Apple’s work to ensure iOS remains the best, most secure mobile platform available in Brazil. App Store commission : Developers with iOS apps on the App Store in Brazil will pay a reduced commission of either 10 percent for the vast majority of developers — including members of the Small Business Program, Video Partner Program, Mini Apps Partner Program, and for subscriptions following their first year — or 21 percent on transactions for digital goods and services. Store services commission : Developers with iOS apps on the App Store in Brazil will pay a commission of 15 percent on transactions for digital goods and services made on a website linked to by the developer’s app. Core Technology Commission : iOS apps distributed outside of the App Store in Brazil will pay a 5 percent commission on the sale of digital goods and services, including paid apps.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was only slightly favored. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
